newsitem.title: INDIA: TENNIS-RADULESCU SWEEPS INTO FIRST TOUR FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-RADULESCU SWEEPS INTO FIRST TOUR FINAL.

text.p: German Alex Radulescu stormed into his first ATP Tour final on Saturday with a 6-3 6-2 win over unseeded Frenchman Gerard Solves in the Indian Open semifinals.
Fifth seed Radulescu will play Swedish sixth seed Mikael Tillstrom, who beat unseeded Romanian Andrei Pavel 6-3 6-3 in the other semifinal.
Romanian-born Radulescu, world ranked 58th, served six aces as he overcame a shaky start in which he dropped service in the opening game.
He broke the 177th-ranked Solves in the sixth and eighth games to pocket the first set, and in the second set, broke the Frenchman in the fifth and seventh games.
"I am obviously glad to make my first final of the (ATP) Tour," said Radulescu. "Last year I reached the semifinals of the Indian Open in New Delhi and now look forward to winning the title.
"Once I broke Gerard my percentage game improved. I was then able to send angular serves and place them close to the line."

Tillstrom ended a seed-scalping spree by Pavel, who had ousted top seed and Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek of the Netherlands and seventh-seeded Magnus Norman of Sweden on his way to the semifinals.
Tillstrom won the first set by breaking Pavel in the second game.
Pavel took a 3-0 lead in the second set after breaking Tillstrom in the second game, but failed to drive home the advantage, dropping service in the seventh and ninth games.
